headline: Fluor Among US Firms Vying for Kenyan Critical Minerals Project
summary: Fluor Corp is among the US companies competing for a critical minerals project in Kenya, according to government statements.
why: Competition for critical minerals projects positions engineering and mining services firms for lucrative resource extraction contracts.

impacts.name: Fluor Corp
impacts.why: Bidding for large-scale mining and infrastructure contracts impacts future revenue pipelines.
